questions.skill: who 定语从句 + that 宾语从句 + 主句谓语
questions.target: who 定语从句 / that 宾语从句
questions.q:
Applicants who believe that a longer résumé automatically proves greater ability often overlook the value of relevance.
哪组句法判断正确？
o: 主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 proves；主句谓语 believe
主句主语 a longer résumé；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 overlook
主句主语 Applicants；who 从句谓语 believe；主句谓语 proves

diag.1: proves 属于 that 宾语从句，不是 who 从句的核心谓语；believe 也不是主句谓语。
diag.2: a longer résumé 是 that 从句内部的主语，不是整句主语。
diag.3: proves 是 that 从句谓语；整句主句谓语是 overlook。

exp.trans: 那些认为简历越长就自然能证明能力越强的申请者，往往忽视了“相关性”的价值。
exp.structure: 原始简单句① Applicants often overlook the value of relevance. ② Applicants believe something. ③ A longer résumé automatically proves greater ability. → ②把 something 换成 that 从句：Applicants believe that... → 再把②变成修饰 Applicants 的 who 定语从句：Applicants who believe that... often overlook...。所以整句主语 Applicants，who 从句谓语 believe，that 从句谓语 proves，主句谓语 overlook。
exp.other: applicant 申请者；résumé 简历；automatically 自然而然地/自动地；relevance 相关性。
exp.meaning: 看到 who 后先划到从句结束，再找主句谓语；who 从句里又可嵌套 that 宾语从句。
exp.rest: 把 that 从句的谓语 proves 误当成外层谓语，或把其中的 a longer résumé 误当成整句主语，都会错过：Applicants 是主句主语，believe 是 who 从句谓语，overlook 是主句谓语。

questions.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

questions.target: these/such 回指 / 原词复现干扰
questions.skill: 原词复现 vs 明确回指
questions.q:
段A：The team lost radio contact, and its spare battery failed.
段B：These failures forced the team to abandon the search.
段C：Another team tested a radio before leaving camp.

哪两个段落之间的衔接最强？
o: A → C
B → C
C → A
A → B

exp.trans: 段A：团队失去了无线电联系，备用电池也出了故障。段B：这些故障迫使团队放弃搜寻。段C：另一支团队离开营地前测试了一台无线电设备。
exp.structure: 段A有两个并列分句：The team + lost + radio contact；its spare battery + failed。段B：These failures（主语，概括前面的两项故障）+ forced（谓语）+ the team（宾语）+ to abandon the search（宾语补足语）。段C的Another team引入另一对象。
exp.other: radio contact 无线电联系；spare 备用的；abandon 放弃；search 搜寻。
exp.meaning: These failures明确回指已出现的两次故障；重复radio一词并不保证谈的是同一团队、同一事件。
exp.rest: 把两个含radio的句子相接，会忽略Another team造成的对象切换。把这些故障放在另一团队测试设备之前，后句没有承接故障结果。先说另一团队测试再说本团队出故障，也没有明确回指建立连接。

questions.q: The damaged page could conceivably contain the date we need, but the faded ink cannot yet be read. Which claim keeps the writer’s certainty level?
o: 页面上已经确认写有需要的日期。
需要的日期很可能就在这一页，比其他页更有可能。
这页或许写有需要的日期，目前仍未证实。
这页故意省略了日期。

exp.trans: 那张受损的页面或许写有我们需要的日期，但褪色的墨迹目前还无法辨认。准确改写保留可能性，并说明尚未证实。
exp.structure: The damaged page是主语，could contain是谓语，the date是宾语；we need是省略关系代词的定语从句。conceivably修饰可能性；but之后the faded ink + cannot yet be read是被动谓语。
exp.other: damaged 受损的；faded 褪色的；ink 墨迹；certainty 确定程度。
exp.meaning: conceivably表示可以设想有这种可能。它既不是已经确认，也不自动表示比其他方案更可能。
exp.rest: “已经确认”抹掉could与无法辨认的限制；“很可能、比其他页更可能”加入原文没有的概率比较；“故意省略”把可能存在日期误写成有意不写，既换内容又补动机。

questions.target: who makes the decision / 谁决定录取
questions.q: The applicant chose which research group to approach, but an external panel decided whether to admit her. Which distinction is supported?
o: The panel chose the group; she decided on her admission.
She controlled both her group choice and her admission.
She chose a group; the panel decided on her admission.
The panel controlled both her group choice and her admission.

exp.trans: 申请者自行决定联系哪个研究组，但是否录取由外部评审委员会决定。她的选择与最终申请成功不是同一个主体作出的决定。
exp.structure: The applicant chose...与an external panel decided...构成两个并列且主语不同的分句；whether to admit her为委员会决定的内容。
exp.other: research group 研究组；external panel 外部评审委员会；admit 录取；approach 联系。
exp.meaning: 必须区分applicant's decision（申请者自己的选择）与applicant's success（由他人评估后能否成功获准），不能仅凭同一个applicant归为同一行为。
exp.rest: 申请者选择研究组，委员会决定是否录取。交换两者主语、把两个决定都交给她或都交给委员会，都不符合原句的角色分工。

questions.q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

questions.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

questions.target: 段尾问题 / 原因解释
questions.q:
前段：The theatre sold every seat at the advertised price. Yet the deposits in its bank account were smaller than the value of tickets sold. The manager began tracing the gap between bookings and payments.
哪个后段最能推进这一问题？
o: Audience surveys ranked music above scenery when asking about favourite parts of the performance.
The booking agency deducted its service fees before forwarding the remaining money to the theatre.
The theatre had used the same stage for years, although its audience changed with each production.
Rehearsals ended later than planned, so actors sometimes travelled home together.

exp.trans: 剧院按宣传价卖出了所有座位，但银行入账小于售票总额。经理追查订票与收到款项之间的差额。订票代理转款之前先扣除服务费，最直接解释这个差额。
exp.structure: The theatre + sold + every seat。deposits + were smaller than + the value of tickets sold是金额比较。正确后段中The booking agency + deducted + service fees；before forwarding说明扣款发生在剧院收到钱之前。
exp.other: deposit 入账款；advertised price 宣传价格；deduct 扣除；forward money 转款。
exp.meaning: 没有One reason或Equally等显眼连接词，也能由段尾的收款差额锁定后段的扣费机制。这是问题→原因，不是看见theatre或audience就接同主题段。证据来自金额和交易阶段，不是一个单词。
exp.rest: Audience surveys解释演出偏好，未说明钱款差额；same stage介绍场地历史，未接收款链；rehearsals和共同回家是演出活动信息，不解释代理转款前少了什么。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Engineers who noticed that the valve was leaking shut down the line. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Engineers / noticed / shut down
the valve / noticed / was leaking
Engineers / was leaking / noticed
the line / shut down / noticed

exp.trans: 注意到阀门漏液的工程师关闭了生产线。按题目要求的顺序，主句主语中心词是Engineers，who从句谓语是noticed，主句谓语是shut down。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Engineers shut down the line；who noticed...修饰Engineers；that the valve was leaking是noticed的宾语从句。三个谓语分别属于不同层级。
exp.other: engineer 工程师；valve 阀门；leak 漏液；shut down 关闭、停运；subject head 主语中心词。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。阀门是that从句的主语，工程师才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the valve只在that从句中作主语；was leaking属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the line是shut down的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.skill: 区分定语从句、宾语从句和主句谓语
nested.q: Editors who learned that the quote was inaccurate removed it from the draft. Which sequence gives the main-clause subject head / who-clause verb / main-clause verb?
o: Editors / learned / removed
the quote / learned / was
Editors / was / learned
the draft / removed / learned

exp.trans: 得知引文不准确的编辑把它从草稿中删掉了。主句主语中心词是Editors，who从句谓语是learned，主句谓语是removed。
exp.structure: 主句骨架是Editors removed it from the draft；who learned...修饰Editors；that the quote was inaccurate是learned的宾语从句。三个谓语属于不同层级。
exp.other: editor 编辑；quote 引文；inaccurate 不准确的；draft 草稿。
exp.meaning: 先找主句骨架，再把who定语从句和that宾语从句分别嵌入。quote是that从句的主语，Editors才是主句主语。
exp.rest: the quote只在that从句中作主语；was属于that宾语从句，不是who从句谓语；the draft是介词from的宾语，不是主句主语。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
nested.skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
nested.q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

nested.target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
nested.skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
nested.q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。

relative.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

reference.q:
段A：The museum lowered ticket prices and added evening hours.
段B：Such changes attracted more local families during the week.
段C：A different museum across town raised its prices last year.

段B中的 Such changes 最直接回指什么？
o: 段A中的降价和延长晚间开放时间
段C中另一家博物馆的涨价
所有博物馆过去一年的变化
local families 本身

diag.1: 段B先于段C，且 Such changes 就近概括段A的两个措施。
diag.2: 题干没有支持“所有博物馆”的泛指。
diag.3: changes 指的是措施变化，不是家庭。

exp.trans: A：博物馆降低了票价，并延长了晚间开放时间。B：这些变化吸引了更多本地家庭在工作日前来。C：城另一边的另一家博物馆去年提高了票价。
exp.structure: 段A先给出两个并列措施 lowered ticket prices / added evening hours；段B用 Such changes 对这两个措施整体回指，再说明结果 attracted more local families。
exp.other: lower 降低；ticket price 票价；evening hours 晚间开放时段；attract 吸引。
exp.meaning: such + 名词 常把前文已经描述过的同类事物/情况概括回指；这里 Such changes = 段A的两项变化。
exp.rest: 后文另一家博物馆的涨价、所有博物馆的泛指以及 local families 都不是 Such changes 的先行内容；它直接概括前文的降价和延长晚间开放时间。

reference.q:
A return is accepted only within thirty days and with a receipt. These requirements apply to online orders too.
These requirements 具体指什么？
o: 网上订单的付款和配送方式
所有商店共同采用的退货政策
三十天内退货并出示收据
已经完成退款的订单处理结果

exp.trans: 只有在三十天内并出示收据，退货才会被受理。这些要求也适用于网上订单。
exp.structure: 第一句：A return（主语）+ is accepted（被动谓语）；only within thirty days和with a receipt并列限制受理条件。第二句：These requirements（主语）+ apply（谓语）+ to online orders（介词短语）。
exp.other: return 退货；receipt 收据；apply to 适用于；online order 网上订单。
exp.meaning: these + 名词可以概括前文的整组条件，不一定只指紧挨着它的一个名词。
exp.rest: 付款配送并未在前句出现；所有商店共同政策扩大了范围；退款已完成是结果，而前句只说明受理退货的两个条件。

reference.target: it / this request / 对象切换
reference.q: Two panels examined a report. The finance panel recommended publishing it in full, while the technical panel asked for more time. This request was granted. Which reading tracks it and This request correctly?
o: it = the report; This request = publishing the report in full
it = the finance panel’s recommendation; This request = more time
it = the report; This request = more time for the technical panel
it = the decision to publish; This request = the finance panel’s recommendation

exp.trans: 两个小组审阅了一份报告。财务小组建议全文发布它，技术小组则请求更多时间。这个请求获准了。it指报告；This request指技术小组请求更多时间。
exp.structure: publishing it in full是recommended的补足内容，it代替前文的report。while对比两个小组的不同动作。This request作后句主语；was granted是被动谓语，回指asked for more time这一请求。
exp.other: panel 小组；in full 全文、完整地；technical 技术的；grant a request 批准请求。
exp.meaning: 跟踪对象时既看名词数与位置，也看动作：publish的是report，asked for形成request。财务组的建议和技术组的请求不能混为同一对象。
exp.rest: 把This request指向全文发布，忽略asked for more time和while的对象切换；把it解释成recommendation，会把publish报告改成发布建议；decision to publish也不是it出现前已建立的实体，且没有说发布决定已经获批。

conceivably.q: If the wind weakens before noon, the ferry could conceivably resume service this afternoon, but the operator has made no promise. Conceivably most nearly means:
o: 必定
或许
故意
表面

exp.trans: 如果中午前风势减弱，渡轮今天下午有可能恢复运营，但运营方没有作出任何保证。
exp.structure: if从句给出条件：the wind weakens before noon。主句：the ferry + could resume + service；conceivably修饰could resume，降低确定性。but后面的no promise进一步说明并不确定。
exp.other: weaken 减弱；ferry 渡轮；resume service 恢复运营；operator 运营方。
exp.meaning: conceivably = 可以设想地、有可能地，强调可能存在但远未确定。
exp.rest: 必定对应确定性，强于could且与未作承诺冲突；故意描述意图；表面描述外观，都不是这里的可能性。

conceivably.q: No existing model explains the readings. They could conceivably point to a new process, although a faulty instrument remains another explanation. Which interpretation is justified?
o: A new process is a possible explanation, alongside an instrument fault.
The readings establish a new process and rule out an instrument fault.
The instrument fault has been confirmed by a separate test.
The new process is less likely than an instrument fault according to measured probabilities.

exp.trans: 现有模型都解释不了这些读数。它们或许指向一个新过程，但仪器故障仍是另一种解释。有依据的是两种解释仍可并存，新的过程只是可能性之一。
exp.structure: No existing model + explains + the readings。They指readings；could point to是谓语。although从句中a faulty instrument是主语，remains是系动词，another explanation是表语。
exp.other: reading 仪器读数；process 过程；faulty 出故障的；rule out 排除。
exp.meaning: conceivably没有把一种可设想的解释升级为发现。another explanation尤其限制了唯一性；也没有给两种解释排名。
exp.rest: establish ... rule out将可能性改成证实和排除；confirmed by a separate test虚构检验；less likely ... measured probabilities补出概率比较，原文没有量化数据。

cloze-applicant-outcome.skill: 区分申请者结果与其本人决定
cloze-applicant-outcome.q: A scholarship committee, not the students, decides who receives funding. In theory, an applicant's ______ should not depend on which other candidate happened to be interviewed immediately before her.
o: success
decision
vision
complaint

exp.trans: 奖学金由评审委员会决定授予谁。理论上，申请者能否成功获得资助，不应取决于刚在她之前接受面试的其他候选人。
exp.structure: A scholarship committee ... decides是前句主干；后句an applicant's success是名词中心，should not depend on...交代不该受谁影响。
exp.other: funding 资助；candidate 候选人；committee 委员会；depend on 取决于。
exp.meaning: success of an applicant在录取或资助语境中可指申请成功；decision of an applicant通常是申请者自己做的决定，而此处决策权属于委员会。
exp.rest: decision会将委员会作出的录取决定错写成申请者自身的决定；vision和complaint与资助是否获批的结果都不相称。

action-collocation.q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

action-collocation.skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
action-collocation.q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
parallel-governance.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
段落甲结尾：Not surprisingly, nearly half of the applicants withdraw before the final interview.
下面哪个段首与它的衔接最强？
o: Equally unsurprisingly, few of the remaining applicants receive an offer.
By contrast, the final interviews take place in the company's new building.
For example, managers from several departments attend the final interview.
In conclusion, a final interview is unnecessary for applicants who remain.

exp.trans: 甲段说“不出所料，近一半申请者在终面前退出”。最强衔接是：“同样不足为奇的是，留下的人中也只有很少一部分收到录用。”
exp.structure: Not surprisingly先给出一个“并不意外”的结果；Equally unsurprisingly显式要求前面已经有一个同类判断，再补第二个并列结果。两个副词短语构成明显篇章钩子。
exp.other: withdraw 退出；final interview 终面；a small share 少部分；receive an offer 获得录用。
exp.meaning: Equally / similarly / also 等段首词常要求前文存在可并列对象。排序题中这种平行措辞比泛泛的主题相似更可靠。
exp.rest: 换到面试地点没有形成真正对立；经理参会不是申请者退出的例子；也不能从退出比例推出剩余申请者无需面试。平行标记与申请者筛选链共同支持承接。

paragraph-order-discourse.q:
一篇先分析家电过早报废、后提出改进办法的文章，有一候选段写道：After examining the figures, Dr Patel sums up her proposal: shared repair services could help residents keep appliances longer. 段末又说：Whether enough households will join, however, remains an open question.
这一段最适合放在哪里？
o: 全文开头，用来首次介绍Dr Patel
问题分析展开之前
全文结尾附近，作为总结和改革建议
只能放在具体数据段之前

exp.trans: 考察数据后，Patel博士总结自己的建议：共享维修服务或许能让居民更长久地使用电器。但是否有足够多家庭参与，仍是未决问题。这段最适合放在结尾附近。
exp.structure: After examining the figures回看前文数据；Dr Patel + sums up + her proposal明确给出总结动作。末句Whether...will join作主语，remains...为谓语部分，以未决问题收束。
exp.other: sum up 总结；shared repair service 共享维修服务；appliance 家电；household 家庭；open question 未决问题。
exp.meaning: 总结建议与回顾数据、开放结尾合起来支持尾段位置；单独出现concludes或sum up并不能证明必为全文最后一段。
exp.rest: 首次介绍人物不能解释已分析过数据；在问题分析前放总结建议与给定结构不合；“只能放在数据段之前”更与After examining the figures相反。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 表面便利 vs 参与不足
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 讽刺语气 + 对比过渡
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：The online course called itself interactive, but students could do little more than click Next after each recorded lecture. The easiest part was operating the screen; the hardest was staying awake.
【空缺】
后文：What would genuine participation require? Students could challenge arguments and revise one another's work.
哪句最适合？
o: The simple controls already give learners an active role in shaping the course.
A redesign could replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion.
Recorded lectures also let learners choose when to watch the same presentation.
Adding subtitles would make the recorded lectures easier for learners to follow.

exp.trans: 前文用带讽刺性的说法指出所谓互动课仍只让学生被动点下一页；正确句转向让学生真正贡献观点的另一种课程；后文追问真正参与需要什么。
exp.structure: but建立宣称interactive与实际只能click Next的矛盾；the hardest was staying awake暗示被动乏味。正确句用replace passive viewing with a real role in shaping discussion提出另一模式，后文再具体说明质疑论点与互相修改。
exp.other: interactive 互动的；lecture 讲座/课；challenge an argument 质疑论点；revise 修订。
exp.meaning: 看到操作很简单，不能自动判为作者赞扬。应结合转折、夸张和后文提问判断作者真正评价：被动消费不足，主动参与才是重点。
exp.rest: 操作简单不等于能参与建构讨论；自选观看时间和字幕提升观看便利，却没有补上后文要求的质疑论点、互评修改等主动参与。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: 单向展示→反向参与→后文设问
paragraph-order-discourse.q:
前文：At the old science museum, visitors watched a machine demonstrate each experiment. The most demanding thing they could do was press the Start button.
【空缺】
后文：What counts as taking part in an experiment? Visitors must be able to change a variable and compare the results.
哪一句最适合？
o: Repairs to the building could give the passive displays a more attractive setting.
Simpler controls could help more visitors watch the same machine demonstrations.
More detailed labels could explain the inventors behind the museum's machines.
A redesign could replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one's own tests.

exp.trans: 旧科技馆由机器单向演示，观众几乎只能按开始按钮。正确句引出新展览如何扭转这种被动观看，让观众亲自试验；后文再问什么才是真正参与实验。
exp.structure: 前文visitors watched与could do ... press Start显示参与程度低；正确句replace watching demonstrations with carrying out one’s own tests对比观看与亲自实验，后文change a variable和compare the results说明这种参与如何实现。
exp.other: demanding 费力的；demonstration 演示；variable 变量；carry out a test 进行试验。
exp.meaning: 最有力的证据是双向：反转被动的安排承接前文，主动测试又引出后文讨论。‘最难任务只是按按钮’在语境中揭示参与不足，不是对设备的夸赞。
exp.rest: 场馆外观、观看操作和发明者标签仍把参观者放在观看或接收信息的位置；只有亲自测试自然引出后文改变变量、比较结果的参与标准。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

paragraph-order-discourse.target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
paragraph-order-discourse.skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
paragraph-order-discourse.q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。

paragraph-order-discourse.q: An energy guide first explains that meter logs locate periods of high demand. A paragraph about equipment inspections follows. The next two paragraphs describe a bakery and a warehouse that combined logs with inspections. What is the role of the inspections paragraph?
o: It completes the methods that the later cases apply.
It summarizes the outcomes reported in the later cases.
It gives a third case after the bakery and warehouse.
It withdraws the claim that meter logs can be useful.

exp.trans: 能源指南先解释用电表日志定位高需求时段，再介绍设备检查；后面两个案例同时使用日志和检查。检查段是在补齐随后案例会应用的方法。
exp.structure: first、follows、next交代段落顺序；combined logs with inspections说明两个案例同时依赖前面两种方法，不是只应用第一段的方法。
exp.other: meter log 电表记录；equipment inspection 设备检查；high demand 高需求；apply 应用。
exp.meaning: 一个方法段结束，不代表下一段必须马上举例。要检查后面案例需要哪些方法说明，再分清并列方法与两则应用案例的层级。
exp.rest: 总结后文结果需要结果性内容，检查方法本身不能当作结果总结；它位于两案例前也不是第三案例；案例同时使用日志，并未撤回日志有用的判断。
